{{Quote|By the way, this is the Weather Walk. That’s what the diagram in the tourist information said. The Weather Walk on Apex Level.|Trey Courser|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
The '''Weather Walk''' was an exterior walkway located at the Apex Level of [[Mount Lyss Meteorological Station]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vandor-3]]. It measured twenty meters long and four meters wide, running along the station's north wall beneath a natural stone overhang. The walkway provided access to the station through a doorway and two broad window openings leading into an interior chamber.<ref name="MK" />
